VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config.VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Descr: System configuration for the Lantern Assembly Editor mode. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by AppCore ConfigLoader and read back through ConfigLoader.GetSection('LanternEditor'). Control bounds live here so no slider limit is ever hardcoded in a module.

VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Layou.SplitNote: Drag the resize handles to live-adjust the controls column width and the 2D/3D share. Split3dOrientation horizontal places drawing left and 3D right; vertical stacks them.

VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Contr.BoundsNote: Min/Max mirror VghLantern__Validation__Config so a slider can never propose a value the ConstraintResolver would reject. Step values are the increments Vale technical staff work to on the shop floor.

VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Contr.BehaviourNote: LiveUpdateWhileDragging redraws on input rather than change. SliderDebounceMs only coalesces the redraw, never the config write, so the value the user releases on is always the value stored. TextCommitDebounceMs coalesces text/textarea keystrokes into one write, flushed immediately on focusout.

VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Viewp.DualViewNote: Dual view stacks a second 2D surface under the primary so plan and an elevation can be compared at once. Orientation vertical = stacked; horizontal = side by side.
VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Viewp.ViewFitMarginFactorNote: Extra breathing room applied once the panes have been put on one drawing scale. The fit is measured from the skeleton members alone, so the dimension chains, the finials and the view title all sit outside it. Stepping the shared scale back by this fraction brings them inside the frame instead of against its edge. Raised from 0.10 when the glaze bar setting out tier was added below the lantern. The plan block is three tiers deep under the near edge: the setting out chain, then the internal upstand chained between its two upstand thicknesses, then the overall external upstand. Raise it again if a plan chain ever runs off the bottom of its pane.
VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Viewp.ProfileTraceNote: Profile traces are off by default in the editor because they read as clutter at configurator zoom levels. The drawing editor turns them on for the issued sheet.

VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Viewp.EnabledByDefaultNote: The 3D panel is opt-in so the editor stays light on first open; the 3D stack is not even fetched until the user asks for it.
VghLantern__LanternEditor__Config__Viewp.AllowBelowGroundOrbitNote: Lets this panel orbit under the ground plane to check the underside of the lantern while configuring it, and drops the ground grid while the camera is down there. Granted here as well as to the full-screen 3D View because configuring is exactly when the soffits matter; the drawing sheet viewports stay clamped above the horizon. Angle limit is Env3d Camera.BelowGroundMaxPolarAngleDegrees.
